independent_semantic_review.finding: The input-format topic plus sdayi (hard/difficult) is followed by vsgihnv iyusdi (therefore/for that reason). The explicit causal connection makes confirmation impossible because of the input difficulty. This is a functional paraphrase of too complex to confirm, not a source-attested software-complexity adjective.

The exact authored topic asks frames (two or more?) before confirming: impossible. It is a polar threshold question, not the earlier unknown exact number. Neither existence of animation nor a minimum two-frame count is asserted. General tali is used rather than the human-noun numeral; ale is attested for or, ugodi for more. Punctuation carries the fragment question; this is not an independently attested embedded-interrogative construction.

The old imperative hisdui is absent. OU492 asduisgv names opening, and the overt AN Paint topic scopes the following result. OU36 has unchanged gesesdi twice with future be glosses. The static-image-only complement plus this copula supplies an actual future prediction, not a command. The future copula is not newly derived open morphology.

Animation keeping is followed by impossible and the same future copula, within the semicolon continuation of the named app opening. This predicts no retained animation on that opening, not disabled Save, source deletion, a known still-only input or an impossibility for other software. No first animated frame claim is made.

The nominal topic and predicative complements make a coherent diagnostic-fragment reading. The static adjective precedes image, consistent with the style guide. Consortium29 provides an independent expression followed by gesesdi, but only as a metalinguistic future-tense entry. It does not prove that this exact impossible+future or image-only+future composition is native idiom. Acceptance is functional/source-compositional, not a claim of demonstrated native fluency.

independent_semantic_review.analysis: Own Chicontepec dictionary PATLA short-vowel entry expressly describes removing a thing and placing another; YANCUILIA independently has old object + ica replacement. The completed preparation form comes from TLACUALTLAMI, prior to exhaustion of prepared food. CILCHILLI supplies axhuelqui plus bare object-marked verb. MAHMAQUILIA supplies an inanimate relative tlen eltoya with location, TLEN permits a headless what expression, and NOPAYOH locates it. Exact computer-storage third-person future is in DIZCOH; it is not borrowed from NCH/NHW. The locative topic and ica ni image distinguish old target from replacement.
